title: Build a reusable human-reviewed workflow
objective: Design a stop condition for an AI-assisted build pipeline.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Make AI preparation repeatable: a set sequence of steps, with human review at each gate and a safe stop when something is missing.

items: **Collect** the permitted sources, and record their versions.
**Extract** claims, each with its source passage.
**Draft** structured outputs: hypothesis, use-case log, DITL tables, and value model.
**Route reviews** to the AE, the SE, and customer owners.
**Log** the approval status before anything is published.

blocks.x: This course's prompt library has separate prompts for research, hypotheses, discovery, DITL, value QA, and readiness review. Together they produce a draft artifact pack and a list of open questions, not an approved Blueprint.
If an internal tool isn't available, use the equivalent structured prompt in an approved environment. If required evidence or reviewers are missing, stop. Don't proceed with gaps.
A reusable workflow puts the human review steps in the process, so they aren't skipped under time pressure.

blocks.title: A reusable, human-reviewed workflow
blocks.alt: A seven-step loop: collect authorized inputs, extract facts, draft, list gaps, check, route reviews, and log decisions, then repeat for the next account.
